name: Furnace Altar Mosaic
disable: DC 17 Thievery check (trained) on the hidden hinge opens the mosaic panel, granting access to the shelves beyond while also disarming the trap
reset: If the trap is triggered to do a Furnace Blast, it resets automatically at the start of the next round. If it's triggered to do a Cataclysmic Blast, it's destroyed and must be repaired.

items.name: Cataclysmic Blast
items.text:
Trigger The mosaic takes damage

---
Effect The mosaic suddenly explodes in a terrific blast of scarlet flame that deals 2d6 fire damage (DC 17 basic Reflex save save) to all creatures within 15 feet of area A19's northern wall and directs a focused beam of fire at the creature that caused the damage for 2d6 fire damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save save) if that creature is in area A19 (a triggering creature within 15 feet of the north wall must attempt the save against both effects).

items.name: Furnace Blast
items.text:
Trigger A creature reaches through the mosaic flame while only one brazier is lit

---
Effect The mosaic fragments flare, dealing 3d6 fire damage to the triggering creature (DC 17 basic Reflex save save).

text: The flames in a fifteen-foot-wide stained glass depiction of the religious symbol of Droskar are more than they seem.
